action.objective: Complete broad coverage over all legal root moves to identify the strongest candidates while preserving reserves for verification.
action.rationale: Broad search is required and no prior analyses exist. Use the full broad-or-multi node allowance of 3000 at depth 4 to cover every legal root move. Material is overwhelmingly favorable, so prioritize moves that maintain king safety, restrict the black king, and avoid any unnecessary tactics. Later verify a single selected candidate with the reserved budget.
